result.topic_en: Derivation of the geodesic (shortest-line) equations for a general quadratic line element $ds^2=\sum a_{ik}dx_idx_k$ by varying $\int\sqrt{\omega}$, ending with a check that $\sum a_{ik}p_ip_k$ is constant along the curve (a first integral).
result.transcription:
4/
$\omega = a_{1,1}dx_1^2 + a_{2,2}dx_2^2 + \dots + a_{n,n}dx_n^2 + 2a_{1,2}dx_1dx_2 + \dots = ds^2$ \quad $\frac{\partial x_k}{ds} = p_k$
$s=\int_0^s\sqrt{\omega}$ ; $0=\delta\int_0^s\sqrt{\omega} = \int_0^s\{\frac12\frac{1}{\sqrt{\omega}}[-\#-](\frac{\partial\omega}{\partial x_h}\delta_h + \frac{\partial\omega}{\partial p_h}\delta p_h)$
$=\int_0^s\{\frac12\frac{1}{\sqrt\omega}(\sum\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k [-\partial s^2-]\cdot\delta x_h [-+2-]\sum a_{i,k}p_i [-\#\#-]\partial\delta x_h \cdot [-\#-] ds)$
$=\int_0^s\{\frac12\sum\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k\, ds\,\delta x_h + \sum a_{i,h}p_i\,\partial\delta x_h)$
$\delta s = \sum a_{i,h}p_i\,\delta x_h - \sum a^0_{i,h}p^0_i\,\delta x^0_h + \int_0^s\{\frac12\sum\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k\,ds - \sum\frac{\partial(a_{i,h}p_i)}{\partial x_h}\partial x_h\}\delta x_h$
$\sum\frac{\partial a_{i,h}}{\partial x_h}p_i\,\partial x_h + \sum a_{i,h}\frac{\partial p_i}{\partial x_h}\partial x_h - \frac12\sum\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k\,ds = 0$
$\sum a_{i,h}\frac{\partial p_i}{\partial x_h}\partial x_h = \frac12\sum\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k\,\partial s - \sum\frac{\partial a_{i,h}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_h\,\partial s$

$\omega = a_{1,1}dx_1^2 + a_{2,2}dx_2^2 + \dots + a_{n,n}dx_n^2 + 2a_{1,2}dx_1dx_2 + \dots = ds^2$; $\frac{\partial x_k}{\partial s}=p_k$ ; {+also+} $\sum a_{i,k}p_ip_k = 1$
$s=\int_0^s\sqrt\omega$ , $\delta s = 0 = \delta\int_0^s\sqrt\omega = \int_0^s\{\frac12\frac{1}{\sqrt\omega}\sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial\alpha}dx_i\,dx_k\,\delta\alpha + \sum_{i,k}a_{i,k}p_k\frac{\partial\delta x_i}{\partial\alpha}\delta\alpha\}$
$\delta s = 0 = \sum a_{i,k}p_k\frac{\partial x_i}{\partial\alpha}\delta\alpha - \sum a^0_{i,k}p^0_k\frac{\partial x}{\partial\alpha}\delta\alpha + \int_0^s\{\frac12\frac{1}{\sqrt\omega}\sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial\alpha}dx_i\,dx_k\,\delta\alpha - \sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial(a_{i,k}p_k)}{\partial\alpha}d\alpha\frac{\partial x_i}{\partial\alpha}\delta\alpha\}$
also:
$\frac12\sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial\alpha}p_ip_k\,ds - \sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial(a_{i,k}p_k)}{\partial\alpha}\cdot\frac{\partial x_i}{\partial\alpha}d\alpha = 0$ \quad $(d\alpha = dx_h ; \frac{\partial x_i}{\partial x_h}=0, \frac{\partial x_h}{\partial x_h}=1)$
$\frac12\sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k\frac{\partial s}{\partial x_h} - \sum_k\frac{\partial(a_{h,k}p_k)}{\partial x_h} = 0$
$\frac12\sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k\frac{\partial s}{\partial x_h} - \sum_k\frac{\partial a_{h,k}}{\partial x_h}p_hp_k\frac{\partial s}{\partial x_h} - \sum_k a_{h,k}\frac{\partial p_k}{\partial x_h} = 0$
oder: $\frac12\sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k - \sum_k\frac{\partial a_{h,k}}{\partial x_h}p_hp_k - \sum_k a_{h,k}\frac{\partial p_k}{\partial x_h}p_h = 0$ \quad $(e=\sum a_{i,k}p_ip_k)$
d.h.
$dx_h : \sum_k a_{h,k}dp_k = p_h : \frac12\sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k - \sum_k\frac{\partial a_{h,k}}{\partial x_k}p_hp_k$

$ds : dx_1 : \quad : dx_h : \quad \sum_k a_{h,k}dp_k$ \quad $[-dx-] : 2\sum_k a_{h,k}dp_k$
$= 1 : p_1 : \quad : p_h : \quad \frac12\sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k - \sum_k\frac{\partial a_{h,k}}{\partial x_k}p_hp_k$ \quad oder $: \frac{\partial e}{\partial x_h} - \frac{\partial\partial e}{\partial x_h\partial p_h}p_h$
Aus obiger Bedingungsgleichung [-mit $p_h$ multiplicirt-]
$\frac12\sum_{i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial\alpha}p_ip_k [-p_h-]\,ds - \sum\frac{\partial a_{i,k}p_k}{\partial\alpha}\cdot\frac{\partial x_i}{\partial\alpha}[-p_h-][-d\alpha-] = 0$ \quad $\alpha = x_h ; \frac{\partial x_i}{\partial x_h} = \frac{p_i}{p_h}$
$\frac12\sum_{h,i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_kp_h\,ds - \sum_{\dots}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_kp_i\,dx_h - \sum_{\dots}a_{i,k}p_i\frac{\partial p_k}{\partial x_h}dx_h = 0$
$\sum_{h,i,k}\frac{\partial a_{i,k}}{\partial x_h}p_ip_k\,dx_h + 2\sum_{\dots}a_{i,k}p_i\frac{\partial p_k}{\partial x_h}dx_h = 0$
$= d\sum a_{i,k}p_ip_k = 0$ \quad (also: $\sum a_{i,k}p_ip_k = 1$ (wie gefordert))
